notes:
Unbox Client 0.2.12 — redemption codes and Logo library

- Added Redeem to the top right of the launcher and in-game skin libraries. Codes can unlock assets and role permissions for verified Microsoft Minecraft accounts. Local accounts cannot redeem.
- Added the Logo library beside the character preview, with the basic Unbox logo available by default. Owned logos can be equipped and are stored on the account.
- Included the approved crown and cash artwork. No creator privileges or crown ownership are granted automatically.
- Retained the 0.2.11 Mouse Tweaks fix, revised skin layout and Windows console-window fix.

Supports Minecraft 26.1, 26.1.2 and 26.3 with native Fabric / NeoForge modules. macOS Apple Silicon and Windows x64 testing builds; existing updater signature retained.

Close Minecraft, then open Settings → Updates → Check for updates → Install and restart. Keep the launcher open for in-game redemption.
